title: canon_commit_check.sh rebuilds an attachment directory without att_dir_of's check
body:
`canon_commit_check.sh` (about :544) rebuilds an attachment's directory from a record path with a sed, without `att_dir_of`'s check that the strip is sound.

Expected: the path goes through `att_dir_of`.

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H4-critic-shell-guards-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
